identity.loc: LOC／月典 = Modular Language Framework／模組化語言框架
identity.lunarunes: LunaRunes／月之符文 = Symbolic Language／符號式語言

current_architecture.formula: Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition
current_architecture.scope_model: The governed data and authority boundary of an instance.
current_architecture.feature_model: Reusable capabilities that consume a Scope without taking ownership of it.
current_architecture.page_composition: A UI page composes a Scope with Features; navigation is a governed mutable Page Composition interface and is not the Canon source.

feature_identities.culture: Culture／文化；文化是文字的演化。

identity_governance.collision_policy: Stop migration and require explicit resolution. Never silently overwrite, merge, renumber or choose the first duplicate.
identity_governance.business_key_policy: Business identifiers remain separate and receive domain-specific UNIQUE constraints.

temporal_governance.unknown_time_rule: Unknown historical times remain null; never invent timestamps.

history_authority_direction.rule: History preserves what happened. Current Canon determines the present interpretation and authority. Historical records may be consulted, compared and recalibrated but never become the sole Current definition.

navigation_governance.rule: NAV may evolve when Current Scope or Feature composition changes. NAV changes must preserve one official NAV per interface, Scope boundaries, canonical identities and synchronized route/runtime/docs/tests. NAV is not Canon authority.

search_statistics.leaderboard: Persist Current counts and apply deltas; do not repeat full-text scans for every display.

historical_boundary: Historical material may remain as source evidence, but deprecated architecture labels are never Current aliases, fallbacks, ownership, classifications or routing identities.
navigation_boundary: NAV is a governed mutable Page Composition interface. Current Scope and Feature changes may update it directly, provided the single-NAV rule, Scope isolation, canonical identities and route consistency remain valid.
